{{Quote|Jarg, did you remember not to take the XT-model bike out today? There was something funny with one of the intakes, and I thought it could jam.|Extract of a Mandalorian datapad|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The ''' XT-model bike''' was a variant of [[AeroChaser speeder bike]] used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] led by [[Sherruk]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. [[Jarg (Mandalorian)|Jarg]] used one of these speeders but was told not to as one of the other Mandalorians thought one of the intakes could jam.
